$comment: The shell launchers, one letter per agent lane. The single source: onboarding-mac.sh / onboarding-windows.ps1 (lib/agents.sh) write the managed block `# BEGIN databayt agents … # END databayt agents` from this file, `kun-ready --fix-launchers` rewrites it, readiness steps launcher.<id> probe it, and Machine -> Settings -> Agents edits it. `agent` is the onboarding selection token; `needs` is the readiness step that installs the CLI. A machine profile (machines/<login>.json) may narrow the set with `launchers: ["c","a"]`.

launchers.name: opencode (tertiary)
launchers.bypassNote: config-level: no flag exists; the step opencode.allow sets "permission": "allow" in ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
launchers.note: opencode on the token pool (omniroute/long): the Keychain pool key is exported, then opencode runs; a capped provider hands over to the next (.claude/bin/kun-oc.sh)

launchers.name: Claude Code free (Nous)
launchers.note: Claude Code on Nous Portal's free models through the Hermes login — $0, its own config dir ~/.claude-free (.claude/bin/kun-free.sh)
